image_description: A dimly lit interior of a Gothic-style chapel or sanctuary featuring a stone altar situated within a recessed arched niche. The altar is a dark, rectangular block structure positioned centrally under the arch. Flanking the central niche are tall stained-glass windows with intricate tracery. Above the altar niche is an ornate stone entablature and a vaulted ceiling with ribbed groin vaults. The lighting is low, creating high contrast between the shadowed altar area and the light filtering through the windows.
